title: Gold Bar XL Hawaiian Sunrise Prefilled Pod + Refill
description: The Gold Bar XL Refill Kit in Hawaiian Sunrise brings together tropical Pineapple, mellow Peach and juicy Watermelon in a smooth, sun-soaked fruit blend. Each pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an attached 10ml refill reservoir, both preloaded with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a satisfying mouth-to-lung (MTL) vape. Designed to fit the Gold Bar XL Prefilled Pod Kit, this refill pack delivers reliable flavour performance and clean vapour production. The built-in mesh coil ensures flavour clarity and consistency, while the self-contained refill format makes it easy to change pods without any mess or waste.
